first_side: What is galvanising?

first_side: Why can galvanised iron remain protected after the coating is scratched?
second_side: Zinc is more reactive than iron, so it oxidises sacrificially instead of the iron.

first_side: What is sacrificial protection?
second_side: Attaching a more reactive metal that oxidises in place of the protected iron or steel.

first_side: Why must a sacrificial metal be more reactive than iron?
